notes: Rate page A872/A8JA72P101 with a channel parameter chid: chid=cmon serves the ふるはーと editions (三井住友信託銀行, しんきんらいふ終身S and the general distributors); chid=smbc (三井住友銀行), chid=pres (SMBC信託銀行) and chid=nkko (SMBC日興証券) serve 笑顔の約束Ⅲ. chid=cgin, smtb and mzho return only a redirect page. Rates are collected from chid=cmon.

Channel comparison (checked 2026-11-17 with scripts/sml.py --channels, current page and full history of every plan and the MVA tab): chid=cmon, smbc and pres return identical values for every period since 2024-04-01 (1024 points compared, no difference). chid=nkko (SMBC日興証券) shows the same values for every period it lists but its history only starts at 2025-04-01 (640 points, all equal to the cmon values). So the rates do not differ by channel; only the history length does. Rates are therefore stored once, from chid=cmon.

Evidence for the channel comparison: only the current pages of chid=smbc, pres and nkko are saved (sources/sml/rates/fh_current_*_2026-11-17.html; all four channels show identical 2026-11-16 values). The history comparison was a read-only run of scripts/sml.py --channels and its pages were not snapshotted, so it can be repeated but not re-checked offline. Added by the independent checker on 2026-11-17.

Two plans: 健康告知なしプラン (no health declaration, 解約控除 for the first 10 years, 初期死亡時円換算支払額最低保証特約 can be added) and 3つの健康告知プラン (no 解約控除; up to 4.5% of the premium deducted at contract). The 市場価格調整 applies to the first 15 years' surrender values.

Metrics: 予定利率 (planned_rate, fixed at contract), 実質的な利回り (net_yield, shown only for a 60-year-old male and female, age_band 60, sex M/F; it depends on age, sex, plan and rider), 市場価格調整用利率 (mva_rate; the site shows one table for both plans, the values are identical for the two plans in the history read). Yields are in the policy currency. term_years is blank: the 予定利率 is fixed for life.
The 健康告知なし yield on the cmon page is quoted with the 初期死亡時円換算支払額最低保証特約 attached (footnote); the smbc/pres/nkko pages carry a different footnote without it.
effective_date is the first day of the contract period (half-month, set on the 1st and 16th). The site labels the column 契約日 but shows the period.

Rate history on the site starts with the contract period 2024-04-01 (the year selector offers 2024 to 2026; the fee page quotes FX rates as of April 2024). The stated on-sale date is in on_sale_date. Currencies USD and AUD only; a dash on the site means a currency was suspended in that period (stored as not_offered).

Distributors: the general list is as of 2026-10-01 from the fi-list page (the page's own sub-heading says 2026年6月1日現在), plus 三井住友信託銀行, しんきん (list of shinkin banks not collected) and the three 笑顔の約束Ⅲ distributors. The fi-list page also links an ntg edition (fullheartjglobal3-ntg), not collected.
Not collected: FX tables on the rate page (snapshotted only); age/sex combinations other than 60; premium bands or loads; brochures (URLs listed under documents).

Launch date: 2024-04-01, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2024-03-21 (外貨建一時払終身保険「ふるはーとＪロードグローバルⅢ」, sold at 三井住友銀行 and SMBC信託銀行 as 「笑顔の約束Ⅲ」). It follows 「ふるはーとＪロードグローバルⅡ」 (「笑顔の約束Ⅱ」). Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 April 2024, with rates set for half-month periods, covering USD and AUD.
Rates are the same across the bank and securities channels, but one channel's history only starts in April 2025; rates are stored once.
Two plans exist, with no health declaration or with three health questions; the planned rate is fixed for life.
The net yield is shown only for a 60-year-old man and woman.
Launched 1 April 2024 (insurer news release). Exchange rates, charges and brochures are not collected.

verification.method: An independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 104 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 104 of 1024 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (0: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (0). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
